subtitle: Breath, heart, water
question: What does moving do to your body?
promise: In this unit you will feel your heart, hear your breath, and find out when to rest and when to drink.
learn: Drink water before you are thirsty

title: What changes
text: Your heart goes faster. Your breath gets quicker. Your face goes warm. That is your body working well.
say: Put a hand on your own chest and ask the class to copy you. Then wait in silence while everyone feels it.

title: My moving body
text: Move fast for one minute. Then stop and feel.
Six bodies, still, looking at clouds.

steps.text: Move until your breath is quick.
Stop. Put a paw on your chest.
Breathe slowly. Count four in, four out.

text: Move fast for one minute. Then sit and count your breaths until they slow down. Nobody is racing you.
ask: How many breaths before you felt calm?

title: Before and after
text: Draw your face before you move. Draw your face after you move.
ask: Draw both faces. Circle the one that is warmer.

words.meaning: it beats faster when you move
stop and let your body catch up
your face and hands feel hot

text: A cup of water on the bench. Cold, and full.
